description: NaSr₂NdTi₄O₁₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅42m space group. Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.95 Å. There are two inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded to twelve O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.62-2.94 Å. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.63-3.06 Å. Nd is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.93 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NdO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-19°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.00 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sr, one Nd, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sr, one Nd, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Nd, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Sr and two equivalent Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OSr₄Ti₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
